runIdValidation.wildcardPrevention: Disallow LIKE; use starts_with(idempotency_key, prefix) with period delimiters (test-run.<RUN_ID>.<SEQUENCE_ID>)
runIdValidation.parameterPassing: Strictly bound parameters via driver ($1), disallow unvalidated string concatenation

rollbackSemantics.rationale: For staging gate validation, any non-test TikTok row indicates uncontrolled environment state. Conservative rollback prevents data corruption and guarantees atomic DDL reversion back to V000008

syntheticRecordEligibility.ownerUid: Must equal authenticated staging QA test user (PO-04 pending)
syntheticRecordEligibility.downstreamFk: job_id IS NULL AND media_id IS NULL
syntheticRecordEligibility.unmatchedAction: Abort transaction via RAISE EXCEPTION prior to DELETE

preFlightChecks: Cloud SQL instance and DB authority tuple verification
Migration file SHA-256 integrity hash verification
Full backup / snapshot verification prior to DDL

sqlAtomicity.guarantee: Failure at pre-check, delete, post-check, or alter table causes full rollback leaving DB and rows completely untouched
